screened.name: Lexus NX 350h
screened.reason: Standard FWD includes Lexus Safety System+ 3.0 and the standard power rear door; no Premium or hands-free-door option is selected. Rear space is adequate; long gear needs a verified carrier route.

screened.name: Mazda CX-50 Hybrid
screened.reason: Preferred is the entry hybrid and already has a powered hatch and heated driver-adjustable seats. MRCC is credited; CTS fitment is unverified and receives no centering credit.

screened.name: Toyota RAV4 Hybrid
screened.reason: New generation, entry LE with Toyota Safety Sense 4.0. No power-door upgrade. Useful cabin and luggage area; FWD tires and clearance remain relevant for winter.

screened.name: Lexus UX 300h
screened.reason: Base seats are power adjustable; ventilation and the powered rear door belong to higher grades. Tight rear seating and luggage room constrain three-adult trips.

screened.name: BMW X3
screened.reason: The referenced $51,300 base + $3,450 Premium/assistance build exceeds $60k OTD after destination/tax/fees. A cheaper fully verified assisted build was not established; this is not a claim that every X3 is ineligible.

screened.name: Mazda CX-30
screened.reason: Turbo Premium Plus is the documented CTS grade; its turbo powertrain and 25-MPG EPA record replace the old non-turbo assumptions. Rear accommodation stays tight.

screened.name: Kia Sportage Hybrid
screened.reason: LX now includes stop/go cruise and LFA2. Cloth/manual-seat equipment is less plush than SX-Prestige, but avoids paying for the old power-door constraint.

screened.name: Mazda CX-5
screened.reason: The all-new 2026 Premium Plus explicitly includes CTS with Lane Change Assist and a power rear gate. Large touchscreen controls and actual ride/noise need a test drive.

screened.name: Hyundai IONIQ 5
screened.reason: Entry SE Standard Range has stop/go cruise and LFA. The 245-mile EPA range is not the long-range model. Spacious flat-floor cabin; manual rear gate at this trim.

screened.name: Ford Mustang Mach-E
screened.reason: Select retains adaptive cruise with lane centering. Technology Package and paid BlueCruise are unselected and receive no hands-free credit. Standard battery has 260 EPA miles.

screened.name: Honda CR-V Hybrid
screened.reason: Entry Sport hybrid includes Honda Sensing and Traffic Jam Assist without Sport-L liftgate pricing. Roomy cabin and straightforward controls; selected cloth/manual-gate equipment matters.

screened.name: Subaru Forester Hybrid
screened.reason: Revised entry hybrid price; EyeSight with lane centering, heated seats and standard powered rear gate. Useful roof/cargo packaging and 8.7-inch clearance; new hybrid longevity remains unknown.

screened.name: Nissan Rogue Rock Creek
screened.reason: SV supplies ProPILOT and power liftgate without Rock Creek packaging. FWD is the cheaper reference build; its 32-MPG EPA record is not the Rock Creek AWD record.

screened.name: Nissan LEAF
screened.reason: Redesigned S+ includes hands-on ProPILOT and has 303 EPA miles. It is not the old CHAdeMO LEAF; Platinum wheels and power-door equipment are unselected.

screened.name: Hyundai Tucson Hybrid
screened.reason: Entry SE FWD has SCC and LFA with 38 MPG. Do not inherit Limited AWD features, powered gate or the AWD energy record.

screened.name: Subaru Solterra
screened.reason: 2026 battery/charging update and 288-mile EPA range replace predecessor assumptions. Standard assistance and AWD; Premium does not receive Limited powered-gate credit.

screened.name: Toyota bZ
screened.reason: Entry XLE FWD uses the smaller battery and 236-mile EPA range; it is not FWD Plus or Limited AWD. Standard Toyota Safety Sense and powered rear door.

screened.name: Tesla Model Y
screened.reason: Cash price before savings/incentives. Paid FSD (Supervised) is selected and costed for five years; driver supervision is mandatory. Sparse physical controls constrain ergonomics.

screened.name: Kia EV6
screened.reason: Entry Light includes HDA and stop/go cruise. The standard-range 237-mile battery is selected; Wind AWD and its powered-hatch equipment are not borrowed.

screened.name: Acura RDX
screened.reason: Base RDX already has ACC, speed-limited LKAS and powered tailgate. No Technology-package price or acoustic-side-glass benefit is assumed. LKAS does not provide low-speed traffic-jam steering.

screened.name: BMW X2
